notes: Hisham bin Hakim is in Umar's scene (Umar heard him recite), not a link; the RWY reading lists him.

fixes.reason: RWY lists Hisham as a transmitter; in the text he is the reciter in Umar's account.

evidence.quote: يقول سمعت هشام بن حكيم، يقرأ سورة الفرقان
وعبد الرحمن بن عبد القاري، هشام بن حكيم
